description:
Arin's only joy in life used to be caring for her little sister. That is... until she went to stop that sister from causing trouble and met Hwi Choi, the chairman of the biggest conglomerate in the country! Arin then turned into a stalker, getting herself a second job as a janitor just so she could see Hwi everyday! However, things take a wild turn when Hwi finds himself falling more and more for Arin too. What will happen to this ditzy cinderella and the clueless crown prince?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/52060807), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/945073421), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=8465065), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/Royalfavor), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000058411)
